question: In relation to the attempt to access Primary Refresh Token (PRT), can you identify the name of the process involved in this activity?
answer: BrowserCore.exe — the PowerShell script get-userprttoken.ps1 (launched via WmiPrvSE.exe) spawned browsercore.exe to attempt access to the user's Primary Refresh Token (PRT).
